name: VaultRequestrr
description: A Discord bot that requests movies and TV shows through Seerr (the Overseerr/Jellyseerr successor). The first time a user requests something, the bot asks for their Plex username/email and links their Discord account to their Seerr user, so every request is attributed to them and their per-user quotas/limits are respected. The link is stored locally (SQLite) and written back into Seerr notification settings. Features: /movie and /tv search with availability indicators and season selection; /quota shows remaining limits and reset time; DM notifications when a request becomes available or is declined; and an optional password-protected admin dashboard (set a Dashboard Password to enable it on port 5056) for managing links, viewing activity, and toggling settings.

paths.name: Data Directory
paths.description: Stores the SQLite database of Discord↔Seerr account links. Keep this on persistent storage.

ports.name: Dashboard Port
ports.description: Host port for the admin dashboard. Only used when a Dashboard Password is set.

variables.name: Seerr URL
variables.description: Base URL of your Seerr instance, including port. Use your LAN address, e.g. http://10.10.0.10:5055

variables.name: Seerr API Key
variables.description: Seerr API key (Settings → General → API Key). Must belong to an admin user.

variables.name: Discord Guild ID
variables.description: Optional: your Discord server ID. Set it so slash commands register instantly (otherwise global registration can take up to ~1 hour). Enable Developer Mode in Discord, right-click the server icon → Copy Server ID.

variables.name: Require Linking
variables.description: Require users to link a Plex account before their first request (recommended: true).

variables.name: Default Seerr User ID
variables.description: Optional fallback Seerr user id used only when Require Linking is false.

variables.name: Dashboard Password
variables.description: Set a password to enable the admin web dashboard (view/manage links, activity, settings). Leave blank to disable the dashboard.

variables.name: Notify When Available
variables.description: DM the requester when their movie/season becomes available.

variables.name: Notify When Declined
variables.description: DM the requester when an admin declines their request.

variables.name: Notify When Issue Resolved
variables.description: DM the reporter when their reported issue is marked resolved.

variables.name: Poll Interval (seconds)
variables.description: How often to poll Seerr for request status changes (0 disables notifications).
